summary: Emergency: tenant optimizer profile change triggered intermittent streaming stalls and token-cost drift - request assisted revert and validation playbook
description: Issue summary: After applying an aggressive tenant-level optimizer profile (policy ID: tenant-opt-ldg-2026), LumenDocs reports intermittent streaming stalls and a 35% increase in per-token billing for a subset of requests. Streaming connections often hang at the 2–4 token window and then resume, leading to client-side timeouts and retries.

Impact: Customer-facing API calls for LumenDocs experienced degraded UX in production for ~12% of sessions. This is affecting search-result generation and document summarization flows. Billing alerts triggered due to token-cost drift compared to baseline.

Observed behavior: - Increased tail latency (95p to 99p) on tenant-pinned model variants. - Elevated token counts for identical prompts (tokenizer traces show repeated prefix re-encoding in some traces). - Streaming sessions entering stalled state and then resuming (connection logs show large gaps of inactivity from runtime).

Customer ask: Immediate assisted revert of the tenant optimizer profile to previous snapshot and a safe validation checklist to avoid re-introducing instability. Customer requests a short runbook to validate restored behavior before closing the ticket.
Business urgency: Customer is on Dedicated plan with production traffic; requests priority handling and post-mortem notes for audit.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Tenant configuration: apply optimizer profile 'tenant-opt-ldg-2026' via Console -> Tenants -> LumenDocs -> Optimizer Profiles -> Activate.
2) Use production request route 'summarize-v2' with payload size ~2k tokens and streaming=true.
3) Observe streaming: agent receives first few tokens then connection stalls for 2–6s before resuming; client may timeout if retry thresholds low.
4) Compare token accounting: run identical prompt through snapshot before and after profile; backend shows ~30% higher token count post-profile in subset of traces.
Notes: Intermittency - not every session reproduces. Higher reproduction rate under burst traffic and when prefix-cache hits are low.

investigation_notes: Hypothesis 1: kv-prefetch with quant profile q4_3 is producing occasional cache thrash leading to re-encoding of prefixes and extra tokens.
Hypothesis 2: Continuous batching parameters (batch_target=512) are delaying small streaming responses and interacting poorly with prefix caching, increasing tail latency.
Metrics observed: 95p latency increased from 210ms -> 480ms for affected routes; KV cache hitrate dropped from 88% -> 61% for tenant keyspace after profile rollout.
Dashboards & evidence: <https://monitoring.redwood.ai/d/tenant-lumen/optimizer-ldg-2026?from=now-2h&to=now>, replay traces saved to s3://support-artifacts/SUP-12899/traces.zip

Buttons tried: rolled back sampled feature flag for kv_prefetch=false on staging variant (internal) and saw improved 95p in canary tests. Full revert required for production tenant to validate effects.
Next steps: prepare atomic revert snapshot for tenant, run dry-run validation against golden prompt set, monitor 95/99p and token accounting for 30m before escalating to customer for re-enable.
risk_mitigation_plan: 1) Create snapshot of current optimizer configuration (tenant-opt-ldg-2026) and store under support snapshot bucket.
2) Apply revert: restore previous snapshot 'tenant-opt-stable-202601' for LumenDocs only (tenant-scoped change) outside global rollout.
3) Gate change with canary: route 10% of traffic for 30 minutes through reverted profile and monitor target metrics.
4) If metrics improve (95p latency reduction >20% and token_count delta <5%), promote revert to 100% for tenant.
5) If revert does not help, escalate to runtime/optimizer owners and roll forward alternate mitigations (force kv_prefetch=false / reduce batch_target).
6) Communicate timeline and interim workaround to customer: temporary rate-limit increase and client retry guidance to avoid duplicate billing exposure.

resolution_notes: 2026-03-14T15:31Z - Full revert promoted to 100% for LumenDocs. Verified 95p latency returned to baseline and token accounting within 3% of historical. No further streaming stalls observed in the 30m validation window.

Root cause (provisional): Interaction between q4_3 quant path and tenant-specific KV prefetch heuristics causing occasional prefix re-serialization and increased tokenization. Triage with optimizer team scheduled.

Follow-ups: - OPT-47: implement a canary-flag at config level to disable kv_prefetch for q4_3 on affected models. - DOC-192: update runbook for tenant-scoped optimizer rollouts with explicit canary steps and token-accounting checks. - Postmortem to be shared with customer within 48h.
Ticket closed pending postmortem and meeting with customer to review changes and billing impact.
